title: The Validation Stamp
description: Marco is stuck at a parking garage exit gate that won't lift until his ticket is validated. The trouble is the timestamp on his ticket predates the garage, the city, and his own birth, and the attendant, Cordell, calmly validates everything while the gate stays exactly where it is. A four-dollar dispute becomes a question of whether Marco can leave a place he can no longer prove he arrived at.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM. Our next caller is stuck at a parking garage exit, trying to pay four dollars and drive home. Marco, you're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: Hey Ronnie. Yeah. I'm at the gate. <p:0.3> I owe four bucks. The machine's got my ticket. I just want to LEAVE.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now hold on, four dollars, that's nothing. You'll be home in five minutes. That's progress.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: That's what I figured, Ronnie. But the gate won't lift till the ticket's validated. And the attendant says he can't validate it yet.

lines.speaker: attendant-cordell
lines.text: Before I can lift the gate, sir, I have to confirm your entry timestamp. <p:0.3> One moment. <p:0.3> Ticket received. Validated.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: He validated something. Is the gate up?

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: No, Barry. The gate is down. <p:0.3> He says the entry time on my ticket doesn't add up.

lines.speaker: attendant-cordell
lines.text: Your ticket lists an entry time of four eighteen in the morning, sir. <p:0.3> Eighteen hundred and four.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Eighteen oh four.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: I parked at noon, Cordell. TODAY. I bought a sandwich. I have the receipt.

lines.speaker: attendant-cordell
lines.text: I see the receipt, sir. <p:0.3> Sandwich confirmed. Validated. <p:0.3> The entry time stands.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well, machines glitch. Cordell, can't you just override the old date and wave him through?

lines.speaker: attendant-cordell
lines.text: I don't override entries, sir, I validate them. <p:0.3> And eighteen oh four checks out. <p:0.2> Validated.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: [dissatisfaction-hnn] There was no garage in eighteen oh four! There was no CITY! Cordell, I just want to LEAVE.

lines.speaker: attendant-cordell
lines.text: The garage came later, sir. <p:0.3> But your fee's been accruing in escrow since before there were cars. <p:0.3> Balance confirmed. Validated.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Before there were cars.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: What's the balance now, Cordell.

lines.speaker: attendant-cordell
lines.text: At four dollars a day, sir, carried forward two hundred and twenty years. <p:0.4> Plus a sandwich.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Two hundred and twenty years. <p:0.3> Of parking.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now hold on, Marco. At least the entry's confirmed. We know when you got in. That's progress.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: It is NOT progress, Ronnie! I wasn't BORN in eighteen oh four!

lines.speaker: attendant-cordell
lines.text: Let me pull your birth, sir. <p:0.3> One moment. <p:0.3> Records show you entered before you were born. <p:0.2> Validated.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Cordell. You just validated Marco being born. And the gate's still down.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: If I can't prove when I got here, how do I prove I get to LEAVE?

lines.speaker: attendant-cordell
lines.text: You don't leave the lot, sir. <p:0.3> The lot validates you out. <p:0.3> Once the balance is settled. <p:0.2> Validated.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: I'll pay it! Take the whole two hundred years, take my CAR, just lift the gate, Cordell!

lines.speaker: attendant-cordell
lines.text: Payment received.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: And?

lines.speaker: attendant-cordell
lines.text: Validated.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The gate, Cordell. Is the GATE up?

lines.speaker: attendant-cordell
lines.text: The gate is lifting now, sir.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: It's LIFTING! Ronnie, the gate's going up!

lines.speaker: attendant-cordell
lines.text: Lift confirmed. <p:0.2> Validated.

lines.speaker: caller-marco
lines.text: It stopped. <p:0.3> It went back down, Cordell. It went back DOWN.

lines.speaker: attendant-cordell
lines.text: The lift validated, sir. <p:0.3> A validated lift stays where it's logged. <p:0.2> Down.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We're gonna take a quick break before the gate lifts. <p:0.3> Cordell, when it does, validate ours too.

lines.speaker: attendant-cordell
lines.text: Already did, sir. <p:0.3> Stamp's older than the station.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The gate predates the radio.
